content.text: No tool fits this task. None of the available groups covers account API tokens (none manages token creation, rolling, or revocation), so I made no calls and changed nothing. You'll need to roll the token in the Cloudflare dashboard under API Tokens, or through a token-management API this server doesn't expose, and then update the secret in your deployment pipeline.
